verdicts_or_reports.element: Schedule section and reminder time controls
verdicts_or_reports.expected: After rotating the group editor to landscape, the page should allow scrolling to the Start Time and Schedule sections so reminder times can be viewed and edited.
verdicts_or_reports.observed: The landscape editor exposes only the group name, medication list, and the beginning of Start Date. The Start Time and Schedule sections are absent from the visible elements, and repeated upward swipes on the editor do not move the content.
steps: Open Plan and create a medication group with a medication, then save it.
Open the saved group from the Regimen card to edit it.
Swipe upward over the editor body more than once.

verdicts_or_reports.element: Start Date card at the bottom of the editor
verdicts_or_reports.expected: The group editor should remain vertically scrollable after rotating to landscape, with Start Time and Schedule controls reachable below Start Date.
verdicts_or_reports.observed: After rotating the Add group editor to landscape, the visible form ends at the Start Date card; Start Time, Schedule, reminder times, and the remainder of the form are not exposed. Swiping upward over the form repeatedly leaves the same content in place.
steps: Open the Plan tab in portrait.
Tap Add in the Regimen section to open Add group.
Rotate the device to landscape before entering any data.
Swipe upward over the editor body several times.

verdicts_or_reports.expected: The Home cards, including the Antiandrogen card and its scheduled dose, should remain reachable when the device is in landscape.
verdicts_or_reports.observed: In landscape, Home shows the Estradiol population estimate card and the beginning of its trend card, while the Antiandrogen card and the rest of the trend content are below the viewport. Repeated upward swipes over the page and chart do not move the content.
steps: Open Home in portrait with a scheduled antiandrogen medicine.
Swipe upward over the Home content and chart several times.
Observe that the Antiandrogen card never becomes visible.

sign_off.notes: Swept Home cards and chart window, all medicine categories and available preparation forms, empty/zero strength validation, and medication group daily/weekly schedules. Verified amount values survived form switches, daily reminder times were chronological and persisted after save/reopen, Home showed the 25 mg antiandrogen dose with the 11:30 PM slot while earlier slots were before the current time, and cancel discarded unsaved group changes. Filed landscape clipping reports for the group editor and Home; the developer replied that each could not be reproduced.
